description: Driving through or next to an active construction zone with workers, heavy machinery, barriers or a stopped police car narrowing the lane.
A cyclist riding close beside the ego vehicle in the right-hand bike, bus or shoulder lane.
A single pedestrian crossing (mostly in a crosswalk, often from the right) into the ego vehicle's path, often while the vehicle has a green light.
Groups of pedestrians crossing the street or intersection in front of the ego vehicle, often with a green light for the vehicle.
Following a bus ahead that is braking or stopped, often on a wet road, with rear-end risk.
A large bus passing close in the oncoming or adjacent lane on a narrow street with parked cars, squeezing the available road width.
Approaching a red traffic light at a signalized intersection, with cars stopped ahead or cross traffic moving, so a stop is needed.
The vehicle directly ahead is braking or stopped, written in the first person (requiring me to decelerate).
Following a braking vehicle, often a white van, on a wet or rainy road.
Routine low-risk following of an SUV in the right lane at a safe distance in light traffic, with nothing happening.
The car ahead is displaying brake lights in slowing urban traffic, so the driver must be ready to slow down.
The vehicle directly ahead is braking in dense or slow traffic, so the driver must keep a safe following distance.
A white car or van ahead is braking, sometimes in a construction zone, at night or merging in.
Approaching a stop sign or stop line at an intersection that is mostly clear, needing a controlled stop.
The ego vehicle approaching vehicles (often a white van) stopped or braking at a red light, with rear-end risk.
A silver sedan or car directly ahead is braking, sometimes in a construction zone.
The vehicle directly ahead is braking, phrased as requiring the ego vehicle to slow down.
The vehicle ahead is braking or stopped for a red traffic light, so the ego vehicle has to slow down.
A car (often an SUV) in an adjacent lane merging, cutting in, passing closely or turning near the ego vehicle.
Driving down a narrow residential street with parked cars on both sides and the path otherwise clear.

Mixed scenes: oncoming cars passing close, stopping behind an SUV at an intersection, yellow lights, braking sedans and a truck turning across; no single theme (these 10 are the first noise answers by segment order, not a sample).
Following braking or slow traffic in heavy congestion on a wet road, with rear-end risk.
A large bus nearby: either followed while it brakes or passing close in the oncoming or adjacent lane.
A cyclist ahead or alongside, often on a narrow residential street or in a bike lane, sometimes with a parked delivery truck narrowing the road.
The vehicle ahead is braking or a queue is stopped at a red light, so the ego vehicle must slow down.
A quiet narrow residential street with parked cars on both sides and a clear path ahead.
Two kinds of frames together: calm following of a white SUV at a safe distance, and pedestrians crossing or large trucks turning at intersections.
Approaching a stop sign or four-way stop with cross traffic or a car stopped ahead, sometimes with sun glare.
